title: AVOLITE — redesign directions
question: Compare the mockups, then choose a direction or request a revision. All are proposals; engineering claims stay unchanged.

options.label: Exhibition Cutaway
options.thesis: Reveal the system as one large annotated cutaway, with evidence clearly separated from design.
options.viewport: Oversized AVOLITE title at left; a dominant layered loop drawing at right; an evidence shelf spans the bottom.
options.risk: The drawing needs disciplined labels so it never implies fabricated hardware.

raised.raise: Every step has a stable label and visible predecessor/successor.
The implemented/designed boundary remains visible throughout the story.
Stage changes use explicit labels and immediate value changes.
Visited, selected, and pending states have distinct text and shapes.
Each chapter has consistent diagram, explanation, and evidence order.
One oversized cutaway owns the opening; surrounding UI stays quiet.

options.label: Signal Atlas
options.thesis: A system atlas with a persistent chapter index and an inspectable evidence plate.
options.viewport: An indexed left column, large system statement, and an inset loop atlas; evidence sits directly beneath.
options.risk: More familiar engineering presentation; distinction depends on exceptional diagram craft.

options.label: Fold Sequence
options.thesis: Each loop step unfolds from a single sheet.
options.viewport: Each loop step unfolds from a single sheet.
options.risk: Judges must learn an unrelated fold notation.
options.case: Less familiar to SIH judges and less clear about evidence than Exhibition Cutaway.

options.label: Exposed Binding
options.thesis: Chapters open beside a continuous structural spine.
options.viewport: Chapters open beside a continuous structural spine.
options.risk: Craft metaphor competes with the RF mechanism.
options.case: Less familiar to SIH judges and less clear about evidence than Exhibition Cutaway.

options.label: Cathode Stack
options.thesis: One active stage is struck forward over inactive states.
options.viewport: One active stage is struck forward over inactive states.
options.risk: Ghost numerals can suggest unsupported telemetry.
options.case: Less familiar to SIH judges and less clear about evidence than Exhibition Cutaway.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Chapters occupy a horizontal perforated rail.
options.viewport: Chapters occupy a horizontal perforated rail.
options.risk: Film scrubbing creates unnecessary navigation work.
options.case: Less familiar to SIH judges and less clear about evidence than Exhibition Cutaway.

options.label: Motion Score
options.thesis: Loop steps occupy a mirrored vertical staff.
options.viewport: Loop steps occupy a mirrored vertical staff.
options.risk: Bottom-up notation is unfamiliar to judges.
options.case: Less familiar to SIH judges and less clear about evidence than Exhibition Cutaway.

options.label: Collision Desk
options.thesis: Huge headlines cross a fragmented system drawing.
options.viewport: Huge headlines cross a fragmented system drawing.
options.case: Less familiar to SIH judges and less clear about evidence than Exhibition Cutaway.

canonCard.label: Instrument Console
canonCard.thesis: A familiar navy engineering presentation with a radar-inspired loop and clear evidence panels.
canonCard.viewport: Large left-aligned headline, restrained circular system diagram, evidence band below.
canonCard.risk: Easy to recognize but closest to the current site and conventional technical portfolios.
